categories.name: Visual hierarchy
categories.rationale: Persistent inline board title/count, readable body and restrained primary actions establish a coherent hierarchy. The empty guide remains disproportionately prominent.

categories.name: Spacing/grid
categories.rationale: Consistent outer gutters and native grouped settings work well. Paragraph-centered row controls and the sign-in keyboard accessory collision reduce precision.

categories.name: Typography scale
categories.rationale: System text styles preserve clear title/body/helper relationships in both appearances. Main reminder paragraphs stay full size; the capacity placeholder still ellipsizes at XXXL.

categories.name: Dynamic Type
categories.rationale: Native XXXL board, sign-in, guide and account evidence now exists and text-height gates pass. Capacity-message truncation and keyboard crowding remain; larger accessibility sizes are not native-screen certified.

categories.name: Light contrast
categories.rationale: Main text and final-row ink remain crisp on semantic white surfaces. Helpers are quiet; disabled fixture controls and disabled capacity input are not enabled-production contrast failures. No numerical contrast audit was performed.

categories.name: Dark contrast
categories.rationale: White board text and final-row ink are strong on black; dark sheet separation is stable. Native Activity text is readable on the captured wallpaper. Disabled fixture dimming is excluded from enabled-control judgments.

categories.name: Iconography
categories.rationale: Preserved SF Symbols, restrained indigo setup icons and monochrome navigation are coherent. Circle/grip placement beside long paragraphs still weakens association with the task beginning.

categories.name: Safe area / Dynamic Island
categories.rationale: Actual top-control safe-area assertions pass and native expanded footer frames fit. Collapsed stills omit the overlay and neither screenshots nor simulator frames certify physical sensor-cutout geometry.

categories.name: Scroll/pull-down / last row
categories.rationale: Real pull/settled-bottom tests now pass with final-text bounds and pixel ink in both appearances, including XXXL. All four bottom captures retain crisp final text above the composer.

categories.name: List rows
categories.rationale: Plain separators, native virtualization and full wrapping are sound. Completion circles and persistent grips remain vertically centered many lines below the beginning of long tasks.

categories.name: Empty states
categories.rationale: All Clear and the permanent composer communicate the next action; all three setup instructions fit at XXXL. The large guide competes with the empty result and is left as clipped fragments during composition.

categories.name: Composer ergonomics
categories.rationale: Actual 44pt field/add/dismiss geometry and focus/dismiss interaction now pass, with bottom anchoring above the keyboard. Disabled capacity text remains truncated at XXXL.

categories.name: Keyboard handling
categories.rationale: Focused email/password and composer clear the keyboard in measured tests. XXXL sign-in Done crowds or overlaps the lower secondary action, and an invalid-frame runtime warning recurs.

categories.name: Sheet presentation/detents
categories.rationale: Account opens large, moves to medium and back, scrolls all actions, dismisses with Done and reopens large in the tested default/XXXL light/dark matrix. Stable semantic grouped backgrounds match native surface discipline.

categories.name: Navigation clarity
categories.rationale: Your Board/count persist at top and bottom; Account and Done are direct and native. Sign-in alternatives remain clear, although their keyboard-adjacent placement needs refinement.

categories.name: Touch targets
categories.rationale: Measured board, composer and account targets now meet 44pt, with actual edge taps, focus and dismissal gates. Sign-in control bounds are tested; simultaneous action/accessory separation is still missing.

categories.name: Haptics
categories.rationale: Source triggers success/error feedback after operations and selection feedback on drag start. Physical perception, timing and duplicate-event behavior remain unobserved; this is a provisional implementation score.

categories.name: Animation/transitions
categories.rationale: Short board transitions respect Reduce Motion and the earlier idle timeout is resolved by the full passing suite. UIKit reloadData continuity and actual motion quality were not observed in a reviewer interaction session.

categories.name: Loading states
categories.rationale: Source has initial loading, retry progress, completion and submit progress with duplicate-operation guards. Native loading layouts and delayed-network timing are still uncaptured.

categories.name: Error states
categories.rationale: Native XXXL auth error wraps fully with recovery guidance. Initial-board, populated-board and account failure surfaces exist in source but are uncaptured; error announcement/focus behavior needs runtime validation.

categories.name: VoiceOver/labels
categories.rationale: Source supplies explicit labels, reorder actions/positions, completion announcements and inbox announcement. Actual traversal/focus after reloads and failure announcement are unobserved; updatesFrequently alone does not prove an error is announced.

categories.name: iOS HIG consistency
categories.rationale: System navigation, grouped sheets, native keyboards and plain collection rows now have appropriate measured targets. Keyboard accessory crowding and paragraph-centered controls remain below native polish.

categories.name: Lock Screen / Live Activity
categories.rationale: New native expanded and Notification Center banners show readable text and intact overflow footer at default/XXXL. Source can undercount hidden lines when an already summarized payload is capped again; true lock, arbitrary wallpaper and physical geometry remain unverified.

categories.name: Sign-in/onboarding
categories.rationale: Unboxed sections remove the previous nested-card problem. Provider/email/password/inbox/error layouts are clearer and wrap at XXXL; keyboard accessory collision and oversized in-board guidance remain.

categories.name: Settings/account
categories.rationale: Native grouped Account is stable at both detents and lower actions/footer are reachable at XXXL. Useful status/value alignment and confirmations are present; actual enabled network/destructive workflows were intentionally not exercised.

categories.name: Performance feel
categories.rationale: The combined suite reaches idle after real pulls and all 261 tests pass; native virtualization and operation guards are sensible. No frame-time, launch-time or perceived interaction recording was assessed, so this is provisional.

categories.name: Delight
categories.rationale: The quiet monochrome board, legible final line and stable compact context feel more precise. Misaligned paragraph controls, capacity ellipsis and keyboard crowding remain conspicuous small rough edges; tactile delight is unobserved.

categories.name: Long text
categories.rationale: Actual-vs-intrinsic reminder height and final-ink gates now pass; XXXL account, error and inbox text remain readable. Capacity-placeholder completeness and Activity summary-count composition remain unresolved.

categories.name: Reduced Motion / Transparency
categories.rationale: Source gates explicit board/tip animations and uses solid composer/error alternatives; unconditional bottom fading has been removed. Real accessibility-setting interaction across app and Activity surfaces is unobserved.

categories.name: Palette / minimalism
categories.rationale: Monochrome board and account, restrained indigo actions, and flattened sign-in honor the requested clean direction. Red is confined to an actual error state; existing wording, branding and icons are preserved.

findings.evidence: The floating Done accessory sits immediately against the lower Use a Sign-In Link Instead action; in dark appearance its upper-left edge overlaps the action’s lower-right text region. Paired Reminders compose references have a dedicated accessory band, but differ semantically and use default type. SignInView.swift scrolls only the focused field to center; current keyboard test checks field maxY and existence of Done, not accessory/action separation.
findings.fix: Reserve a real keyboard-accessory inset or scroll the entire email/password action group above the accessory. Keep Done and Use a Sign-In Link Instead, all icons and wording unchanged; retain at least 44pt hit regions.
findings.basis: observed + source-derived coverage gap; exact layout cause not isolated
findings.check: Extend SignInSurfaceUITests/testFocusedEmailAndPasswordClearKeyboardInBothAppearances with settled default/XXXL email/password states in both appearances: assert secondary-action frame does not intersect Done or keyboard, leaves an optical gap, and can be edge-tapped independently. Tap Done and require keyboard dismissal. Run all existing iOS tests.

findings.check: Add a native capacity-message geometry/raster check at XXXL and accessibility sizes in light/dark: full exact string must wrap without ellipsis or clipping, allocated height must meet intrinsic height, and final-row ink must still clear the expanded composer. Keep current 44pt and final-ink gates; run existing suite.

findings.evidence: Circles and six-dot grips remain near paragraph centers, several lines below each task beginning. The paired native Reminders top images align completion circles with first-line regions. The source Label and hosting HStack retain default center alignment; app fixture paragraphs are substantially longer than the Apple tasks.
findings.fix: Top-align the existing completion-circle and drag-grip containers to the first-line region with a consistent optical inset. Keep the exact symbols, wording, full text height and at least 44pt target geometry.

Assert control centers align with first-line region rather than paragraph midpoint, targets remain at least 44pt, and completion/reorder gestures and accessibility Move up/Move down still work. Run existing suite.

findings.screen: empty-light-default-top.png; empty-dark-default-top.png; extras/empty-light-XXXL.png; extras/empty-dark-XXXL.png; all composer captures
findings.evidence: The setup guide dominates the lower empty canvas; keyboard-focused composer captures leave only partial first/second instruction fragments directly above the field. Empty-light Reminders is far quieter, although it has no equivalent setup instructions. The app guide is scrollable and dismissible, so the clipped viewport is not proof that text is unreachable.
findings.fix: Retain every existing instruction and Dismiss tip action, but reduce the guide’s initial visual weight and move it wholly out of the focused-composer viewport while the keyboard is visible; restore it when focus ends unless permanently dismissed. Avoid adding nested cards or new copy.
findings.basis: observed + source-derived; severity is visual hierarchy, not data loss
findings.check: Capture first-empty, dismissed-empty and focused/unfocused composer at default/XXXL in light/dark. Verify every instruction remains reachable when appropriate, dismissal persists, and keyboard focus never leaves a severed instruction fragment adjacent to composer. Run BoardSetupTip tests and existing suite.

findings.screen: Source: ios/Shared/ReminderAttributes.swift lines(from:), surfaceLines(_:limit:), capped(_:limit:); ios/Shared/LockScreenLineBudget.swift ReminderActivityLinesView
findings.evidence: Production lines(from:) first caps flattened reminder lines and can insert +N more. ReminderActivityLinesView later calls surfaceLines, which caps that array again and counts the prior summary as one line. Example: five visible lines plus +5 more, capped to four rows, yields three visible lines plus +3 more although seven original lines are hidden. Multiline reminders can reach this path within the board’s reminder-count limit. Native Activity fixtures inject eight raw lines directly, so their correct +5/+6 footers do not cover this case.
findings.fix: Preserve the total hidden-line count as structured presentation data through payload and surface caps, or otherwise make repeated capping account for an existing summary without treating user text as metadata. Keep the exact +N more wording and all visible reminder text unchanged.
findings.basis: source-derived conditional defect; not observed in the eight-raw-line capture fixture; no new test executed by reviewer
findings.check: Add a production-pipeline regression using multiline Reminder values: after payload cap and smaller island/lock-screen cap, assert displayed original lines plus hidden count equals total flattened originals. Include the five-visible-plus-five-hidden then limit-four example expecting +7 more. Keep payload <=4096 bytes, Unicode cases, native footer geometry and existing 261-test suite.

findings.evidence: Invalid frame dimension (negative or non-finite) recurred once in testFocusedEmailAndPasswordClearKeyboardInBothAppearances. The test passed; the warning is unresolved and is separate from assertion results. No captured still proves a negative-frame visual failure, and the precise originating view is not isolated.
findings.fix: Isolate the warning during keyboard show/focus scrolling and correct the non-finite/negative layout proposal at its source without suppressing the diagnostic or changing any copy. Keep the actual field/keyboard and action separation checks.
findings.confidence: high for warning occurrence; medium for user-visible impact
findings.basis: observed structured runtime diagnostic; causal attribution unconfirmed
findings.check: Run the complete sign-in default/XXXL, light/dark email/password keyboard matrix with runtime issue collection and require zero invalid-frame diagnostics alongside all geometry assertions. Repeat transitions enough to reproduce the prior warning and record command/source SHA. Run existing suite.

findings.screen: Source: SignInView.swift auth.notice observer; ReminderListView.swift presentError/BoardErrorBanner; AccountView.swift error section
findings.evidence: Success/inbox and reminder completion explicitly post announcements; new auth and board/account errors rely on updatesFrequently traits and haptics. That is insufficient evidence that a user whose VoiceOver focus remains in an input hears the new failure. No VoiceOver session was supplied, so missed announcement is a risk, not an observed accessibility failure.
findings.fix: Use a deliberate announcement or accessible focus policy for newly presented errors while retaining existing error wording and avoiding duplicate announcements. Keep the user’s editing context when recovery is local.
findings.check: With VoiceOver enabled, trigger first-load, populated-board, auth and account errors from a controlled offline fixture. Require the existing error text to be announced once and recovery control reachable in a predictable order; verify focus after retry, list reload and sheet dismissal. Run existing suite.
